snippet.title: The Rabbit Haul - New Features Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A demo features update for The Rabbit Haul. Nurture your farm by day and defend your haul of crops from the thieving Trash Panda Posse at night. This farming and tower defense roguelite challenges you to grow powerful and symbiotic defenses to battle tough critters and rebuild your hometown one haul at a time! 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
